title: Keep Foot's font size when changing the font
head: 9bb2d7faabcb

leads.summary: New regression test hardcodes a size that open typography PR #13206 changes
leads.consequence: If #13206's bin/omarchy-display-text-size lands first, its SHELL_DEFAULT_PX=13 turns size 16 into 11pt rather than 12pt. This PR's unchanged test fails at its FIRST Foot assertion (`not ok - size command scales Foot`) before exercising the changed font-set line, even though the family-preserving code is unaffected. The shell runner then reports a failed test file and test/all fails; subsequent invocations keep reporting the same false failure. Make the assertion measure and preserve the size written by the display command, or coordinate expected sizes when #13206 lands.

leads.summary: Duplicate #6958 cannot be combined unchanged: same Foot hunk and incompatible fallback assertion
leads.consequence: Both address #6957, but #6958 reads only primary :size= then rewrites the full Foot font line, discarding fallbacks, while #13503 preserves the comma suffix. Git merge-file with #6958's own merge-base exits 1 at the Foot hunk. Even after choosing #13503's implementation, #6958's test/cli exact-match `font=Test Font:size=12` fails on its fixture containing a Noto Color Emoji fallback: actual output keeps `, Noto Color Emoji:size=10`. If both PRs proceed, explicitly pick a fallback policy and adapt both test suites; individually MERGEABLE with quattro does not establish compatibility with each other.
leads.triage: already in Opus final; corroboration; published in Other open PRs block

leads.summary: Machine-local font-size PR #11487 moves the very file this test expects to change
leads.consequence: Open #11487 changes omarchy-display-text-size to call omarchy-font-size, which writes `~/.config/foot/local.ini`, then includes it from `foot.ini`; its font-set also updates local.ini's family. This PR only edits and checks the shared foot.ini; if both are merged without adapting the new test, after text size 16 the effective Foot font is 12pt in local.ini while shared foot.ini retains its stock 9pt (or no explicit size in #11487's new stock config), so `grep '^font=...:size=12$' foot.ini` fails before testing font-set. A three-way merge with #11487's own merge-base also conflicts in font-set:50-66. Rework the test and family's target after deciding whether #11487's overlay feature will land.
leads.triage: factual; coordinator verified from intake/pr11487.diff; published in same-line PR note

leads.summary: Parallel escaping, XDG and symlink fixes all conflict with the new Foot sed line
leads.consequence: The #13503 hunk conflicts in isolated three-way merges with #12457 (escapes `/`, `&`, backslash in sed and XML), #10811 (validates family plus escapes sed), #8179 (uses XDG_CONFIG_HOME for Foot and escapes replacements), and #7309 (adds `--follow-symlinks` and a repository-wide test forbidding bare `sed -i` on user configs). If a conflict is resolved by keeping this PR's raw sed unchanged, #12457's accepted `Fake/Font & Friends` fails its Foot assertion, #8179's non-default XDG Foot path is ignored, and #7309's new `sed-follow-symlinks-test.sh` flags this changed line and dotfile symlinks are replaced. These are conditional integration failures, not fresh standalone regressions of #13503. Merge the per-feature guard/escaped value/config path/follow-symlinks into the chosen size-preserving expression and run the other PRs' fixtures.
leads.triage: already in Opus final; #8179 omitted publicly (already conflicts with quattro per Opus)

leads.summary: Fallback preservation, a stated behavior, is not tested by the new test
leads.consequence: Both new cases have a single font and colon options; neither has a comma-separated fallback. A plausible replacement preserving the first font's `:size`/`:weight` but dropping `, Noto Color Emoji:size=10` passes both assertions. A subsequent selection silently removes the user's explicit fallback list, reducing glyph coverage; later runs cannot restore it. Add a fixture with at least one fallback and assert its exact retention. The PR head itself preserves fallback correctly; this is a test-fidelity issue rather than a demonstrated production regression.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** No defects found in the fix; the new test hardcodes the text-size mapping and fails once open #13206 lands.

### New test hardcodes the 16px → 12pt mapping

The test asserts `size=12` after `omarchy-display-text-size 16`, which checks the text-size anchor rather than font-set. Open #13206 sets `SHELL_DEFAULT_PX=13` (16px → 11pt). With both PRs merged, or only that anchor change at 9bb2d7fa, it fails with `not ok - size command scales Foot`, though font-set still keeps the size. **Impact:** test-only; whichever PR lands second has to update this assertion, or `test/shell` goes red.

**Suggested change:** read the size back after the text-size command and assert that font-set keeps it (variant below also covers fallback fonts).

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 9bb2d7fa with the #13206 anchor)</summary>


`test/shell.d/foot-font-size-test.sh` asserts `font=JetBrainsMono Nerd Font:size=12` after `omarchy-display-text-size 16`. That value comes from the current 12px -> 9pt anchor (`SHELL_DEFAULT_PX=12`). Open PR #13206 changes the anchor to 13px, so 16px maps to 11pt and the test's first assertion fails, although font-set still keeps the size.

### A. At 9bb2d7fa, with only the anchor that #13206 sets

```bash
git fetch origin pull/13503/head
git switch --detach 9bb2d7faabcb0fe22c6d8e7cee8e1198345bcfbf
sed -i 's/^SHELL_DEFAULT_PX=12$/SHELL_DEFAULT_PX=13/' bin/omarchy-display-text-size
bash test/shell.d/foot-font-size-test.sh; echo "exit $?"
git checkout -- bin/omarchy-display-text-size
```

Actual output:

```
not ok - size command scales Foot
exit 1
```

### B. With both PRs merged onto quattro b421b1b4

```bash
git fetch origin quattro pull/13503/head:pr-13503 pull/13206/head:pr-13206
git switch --detach origin/quattro
git merge --no-edit pr-13503
git merge --no-edit pr-13206
# #13206 already conflicts with quattro in shell/Ui/OpticalGlyph.qml and
# test/shell.d/bar-icon-geometry-test.sh. Neither file is used by these tests;
# take the quattro side and commit:
git checkout --ours shell/Ui/OpticalGlyph.qml test/shell.d/bar-icon-geometry-test.sh
git add shell/Ui/OpticalGlyph.qml test/shell.d/bar-icon-geometry-test.sh
git commit --no-edit
bash test/shell.d/text-size-default-test.sh; echo "exit $?"
bash test/shell.d/foot-font-size-test.sh; echo "exit $?"
```

Actual output:

```
ok - shell theme, fallback, and display slider use the new defaults
ok - first run sets GTK font to 9pt without scaling
ok - all seven slider stops scale the shell, GTK, and four terminals
ok - reset restores 13px shell, 9pt terminals, and GTK scale 1.0
ok - changing the font family preserves Foot's 9pt default
exit 0
not ok - size command scales Foot
exit 1
```

### Anchor-independent variant (checked)

Reading the size back instead of hardcoding it keeps the test on the property it is named for. This variant, with the fallback case added, passed at 9bb2d7fa, at 9bb2d7fa with `SHELL_DEFAULT_PX=13`, and on quattro + #13503 + #13206, and failed on the merge-base 3faafba2 with `font=Test Font:size=9` / `not ok - font command keeps Foot's size`:

```bash
cp "$ROOT/config/foot/foot.ini" "$foot_config"
run_command omarchy-display-text-size 16
size=$(sed -n 's/^font=[^:,]*:size=\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' "$foot_config")
[[ -n $size && $size != "9" ]] || fail "size command scales Foot" "$(grep '^font=' "$foot_config")"
run_command omarchy-font-set 'Test Font'
grep -qx "font=Test Font:size=$size" "$foot_config" || fail "font command keeps Foot's size" "$(grep '^font=' "$foot_config")"
pass "changing the font family keeps the size set by the text size command"

sed -i 's/^font=.*/font=Old Font:size=11:weight=medium, Noto Color Emoji:size=11/' "$foot_config"
run_command omarchy-font-set 'Test Font'
grep -qx 'font=Test Font:size=11:weight=medium, Noto Color Emoji:size=11' "$foot_config" || fail "font command keeps Foot's font options and fallbacks" "$(grep '^font=' "$foot_config")"
pass "changing the font family keeps Foot's other font options and fallback fonts"
```

Actual output of the variant at 9bb2d7fa:

```
ok - changing the font family keeps the size set by the text size command
ok - changing the font family keeps Foot's other font options and fallback fonts
```
</details>

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Verified** (real `omarchy-font-set` against a fake `$HOME`, base 3faafba2 vs head):
- Issue #6957 sequence: base resets Foot to `size=9`; head keeps `size=12`.
- `:pixelsize=`, `:weight=` and comma-separated fallbacks (`…:size=12, Noto Color Emoji:size=10`) are kept; the family is replaced; repeated runs are idempotent for ordinary family names.
- #13206's own Foot assertion (`text-size-default-test.sh`) passes with this PR merged.
- The new test is discovered by the `test/shell.d/*-test.sh` glob, is hermetic, and fails on base with `font=Test Font:size=9`.

**Optional note (pre-existing, unchanged by this PR):** a family containing `/` or `&` still breaks the Foot `sed` (`/` makes sed fail and leave the file unchanged; `&` splices in the matched text). The Kitty branch already escapes `[\\&/]`; reusing that escaping here would close it.

**Same-line open PRs:** #7309, #10811, #11487 and #12457 also edit this Foot line and conflict with this PR after it lands (#11487 also moves the Foot size into a machine-local `local.ini`, so this test would need rewriting there). #7309, #10811 and #12457 still write `:size=9` in their version of the line, so taking their side in a conflict would bring the bug back.
</details>

<details><summary>Other open PRs for this issue</summary>

- #6958: rewrites the whole line as `font=<name>:size=<n>` (default 9), so it drops fallback fonts and other options and turns `pixelsize` or a missing size into `size=9`; it conflicts with this PR in `bin/omarchy-font-set`, and its `test/cli` assertion `font=Test Font:size=12` fails against this PR's output, so only one of the two can land as-is.


### Merge conflict

```bash
git fetch origin quattro pull/13503/head:pr-13503 pull/6958/head:pr-6958
git switch --detach origin/quattro        # b421b1b4
git merge --no-edit pr-13503
git merge --no-edit pr-6958
git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
```

Actual output (commit and quattro tip as of 2026-09-29):

```
$ git merge --no-edit pr-13503
Merge made by the 'ort' strategy.
 bin/omarchy-font-set                |  3 ++-
 test/shell.d/foot-font-size-test.sh | 34 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 36 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
 create mode 100755 test/shell.d/foot-font-size-test.sh
$ git merge --no-edit pr-6958
Auto-merging bin/omarchy-font-set
CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in bin/omarchy-font-set
Auto-merging test/cli
Automatic merge failed; fix conflicts and then commit the result.
$ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
bin/omarchy-font-set
```

### Opposite fallback behaviour

Starting from the Foot line that #6958's own test uses, `font=JetBrainsMono Nerd Font:size=12, Noto Color Emoji:size=10`, and running the real `omarchy-font-set 'Test Font'` from each branch against a fake `$HOME` (stubbed `fc-list`, `pkill`, `pgrep`, `gsettings`, `omarchy-restart-shell`, `omarchy-hook`, `omarchy-notification-send`):

```
#13503 (9bb2d7fa): font=Test Font:size=12, Noto Color Emoji:size=10
#6958  (ff6cacf4): font=Test Font:size=12
base   (3faafba2): font=Test Font:size=9
```

#6958's `test/cli` asserts the whole line with `grep -qx 'font=Test Font:size=12'` (line 281 at ff6cacf4), so that assertion fails against #13503's implementation. The two PRs encode opposite fallback behaviour, so only one of them can land as-is.
</details>
